summary: Reads a mutex-protected integer value from the object. Waits on the mutex handle at this+0x50 with the configured timeout at this+0x54, reads the value at this+0x4C when the wait succeeds (result 0 or 128), releases the mutex, and returns that value. Returns -1 when the mutex handle is null or the wait fails.

operations.description: Guard on the mutex handle at this+0x50 being non-null; when null the function skips the wait and returns the default -1.
Call WaitForSingleObject on the mutex handle at this+0x50 with the timeout at this+0x54, and store the wait result.
Guard on the wait result being 0 (WAIT_OBJECT_0) or 128 (WAIT_ABANDONED); only then is the protected value read.
Read the protected integer value at this+0x4C into the result when the wait succeeded.
Re-check the mutex handle at this+0x50 for non-null before releasing it.
Call ReleaseMutex on the mutex handle at this+0x50 after the value read.
Return the read value, or the default -1 when the mutex was null or the wait failed.

unresolved: Meaning of the protected integer at this+0x4C is not established from this function alone.
Semantics of the timeout value at this+0x54 (units, sentinel values) are caller-side.
